intended_behavior: Enhance the respond method to preserve its current functionality of constructing messages, retrying LLM calls, and handling budget exceeded errors with fallback to local models. Additionally, implement token usage tracking and cost estimation based on LLM requests and responses. Proactively warn users about high token consumption or approaching budget limits before or after sending requests. Optionally, prompt users to confirm proceeding if the cost or token usage is high. This will provide transparency and cost control to prevent users from unexpectedly exceeding their budgets while maintaining existing behavior.
